args.goal: Check for equivalent work, then inspect at most two first-party agency partner intake pages outside the existing WebSharx and Agency Media work. If a route qualifies, reuse the agency launch QA delivery control after verifying its receipt. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external contact, spending or deployment.
